newsitem.title: USA: Ameritech, LCI sign Ohio resale pact. [CORRECTED 22:55 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Ameritech, LCI sign Ohio resale pact. [CORRECTED 22:55 GMT]

text.p: Ameritech Corp and LCI International Inc said Tuesday they negotiated a one-year (corrects from three-year) agreement under which LCI can offer local phone services to Ameritech customers on a resale basis in Ohio.

Under terms of the agreement, LCI will buy local phone services from Ameritech at a discount and then resell those services to business and residential customers in Ameritech's Ohio service territory.
For the pact to take effect, it must be approved by the Ohio Public Utilities Commission.
